# Dhruv Solanki (Dhruv Dinesh Solanki)
> Software Architect & Founder based in Mumbai, India | Specializing in Statutory B2B SaaS, Cloud Systems & Autonomous AI.

## Identity & Biography
Dhruv Solanki (Dhruv Dinesh Solanki) is a software architect and technology founder based in Mumbai, India. He is the founder of ESG Tech Sol (developers of the ESGXpert enterprise compliance platform), co-founder of VAPOURBIT, and co-author of autonomous incident triage research registered under Government of India Copyright ROC SW-2026023768.

- **Full Legal Name:** Dhruv Dinesh Solanki
- **Known As:** Dhruv Solanki
- **Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (19.0760° N, 72.8777° E)
- **Role:** Software Architect & Founder
- **Education:** Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (Class of 2026), VIVA Institute of Technology, University of Mumbai
- **Official Website:** https://dhruvsolanki.dev
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhruv-solanki-4301a2327

## Executive Ventures

### ESG Tech Sol (ESGXpert Platform)
ESGXpert is an enterprise B2B SaaS platform founded by Dhruv Solanki automating corporate greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting and statutory SEBI BRSR Core compliance in India. It computes Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 emissions according to Central Electricity Authority (CEA) and GHG Protocol baselines, generating audit-ready regulatory filings.
- **Website:** https://www.esgxpert.com
- **Core Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker, Node.js
- **Jurisdiction:** Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) & ISO 14001

### VAPOURBIT Systems
VAPOURBIT is a cloud systems and backend infrastructure engineering studio co-founded by Dhruv Solanki. It delivers high-throughput distributed microservices, asynchronous worker queues, and enterprise AI workflow integrations with sub-20ms latency bounds.
- **Website:** https://vapourbit.com
- **Core Stack:** Node.js, FastAPI, Docker, AWS (EC2/S3), Redis, PostgreSQL

### Hyuzz Color Engine
Hyuzz is a lightweight browser utility developed by Dhruv Solanki for digital artists and design systems engineers, featuring raw HTML5 Canvas sub-pixel color sampling and real-time hexadecimal harmonic search algorithms.
- **Website:** https://hyuzz.vercel.app/app
- **Core Stack:** HTML5 Canvas, React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS

---

## Statutory Research & Intellectual Property

### AutoTriage AI Engine (Government of India Copyright)
AutoTriage AI is a peer-reviewed research project and software engine co-authored by Dhruv Solanki that investigates hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG-lite) vector similarity combined with deterministic intent heuristics to eliminate manual triage latency in high-volume enterprise software systems.
- **Copyright Registration:** Government of India ROC SW-2026023768
- **Diary Number:** SW-6982/2026-CO
- **Academic Publication:** Presented at National Conference on Recent Trends in Engineering & Non-Conventional Energy (NCRENB-2026)
- **Co-Authors:** Dhruv Dinesh Solanki, Prashik Prakash Ubale, Sarthak Prakash Mudras
- **Affiliation:** University of Mumbai
- **Benchmark:** Achieves <15ms median inference latency with 98.4% vector classification accuracy.
